snippet.title: Soft Fork | Game of Mods
snippet.description:
An illicit bodyware clinic under a freight line. Four people carrying pieces of the same dead woman — and the man who wants them back.

Speak to any of them, or type. They answer you in their own voice, and every word is generated on your own Mac. No account, no internet connection, nothing sent anywhere.

Soft Fork is a journey for Game of Mods, in development for macOS on Apple Silicon.

Wishlist on Steam
